candidate.scope: public Phase-1B implementation and tests; mostly deterministic fixture/control-plane evidence, not proof of live remote-provider exactly-once evaluation or long-horizon statistical safety

logical_identity.evidence: evaluation_jobs keeps one stable job_id while attempts and fencing_token increase across lease/retry

retry_fencing.evidence: claim_job atomically reclaims expired jobs, increments attempts/fencing/version; complete_job requires current worker/token/version/unexpired lease

durable_result_identity.evidence: complete_job derives a stable observation_id from job_id and inserts observation plus marks the same job completed in one PostgreSQL transaction

stale_worker_rejection.evidence: storage durable-flow tests exercise lease expiry/reclaim and reject stale completion

provider_dispatch_prepare.evidence: WorkerRunner claims the job, calls evaluator.evaluate_job(), then calls complete_job(); no durable provider-effect intent/receipt is between lease and evaluator call in this path

provider_side_idempotency.risk: a live external evaluator/model call could finish, worker could die before durable completion, and the same logical job could later be re-leased and physically evaluated again

logical_query_statistical_charge.risk: no inspected durable one-time query/alpha/e-value charge is bound to job_id before first physical evaluation attempt

candidate_local_sequential_validity.observed_statistics: paired stratified bootstrap with multiplicity adjustment is present, but not an anytime-valid e-process/confidence-sequence contract

synapsekit.observation: recent public SelfImprovingAgent evaluates candidate prompts and appends JSONL audit records, but inspected execution lacks stable logical evaluation IDs, durable pre-dispatch evaluation consumption, sequential statistical acceptance, and crash-atomic promotion/audit ordering

composed_minimum_transaction: create stable logical_evaluation_id and immutable evaluator/candidate/split manifest
durably reserve exactly one logical query plus candidate-local/cross-candidate statistical budget before any physical attempt
for each retry, create an attempt under the same logical_evaluation_id with a fencing token
before remote evaluator/model dispatch, persist provider-effect intent plus idempotency key or reconcile against an independent provider receipt ledger
settle result or durable UNKNOWN without blind replay
atomically bind the accepted physical result to the one logical evaluation record
release selection feedback at most once and durably advance candidate-local statistical state
durably charge cross-candidate spending at the defined decision boundary
bind promotion/rejection to exact candidate artifact and evaluation/statistical state
SIGKILL-test every boundary and compare logical query count, physical dispatch count, feedback, statistical state, lineage, and outer-test behavior with an uninterrupted run
falsifiers: same logical job can consume a remote holdout/provider twice after crash without an idempotent receipt/reconciliation rule
retry refunds or duplicates query/statistical budget
same result can release selection feedback twice
stale fenced worker can settle or promote
promotion can commit before evaluation/statistical consumption is durably bound
restart changes candidate-local or cross-candidate statistical state relative to uninterrupted execution
exact_next_action: Search public live self-improving/autoresearch systems for the missing bridge: a stable logical evaluation ID plus provider-side idempotency/receipt reconciliation and durable one-time statistical consumption. If none is found, build or locate a minimal crash-injection prototype combining AegisEvo-style logical job/fencing, provider-effect prepare-dispatch-settle semantics, and dsh-autoresearch-style immutable attempt evidence; then kill the controller at each boundary and compare against uninterrupted execution. Continue separately searching for candidate-local anytime-valid promotion, durable proposal-crossing statistical spending, bounded selection-feedback bandwidth, immutable promotion identity, complete chronology, and an adaptive-selection-unused outer test.
